name: Nurture
job: Long-tail nurture. Also owns the renewal_date contact-field trigger. The renewal sub-flow is blocked until backfill is complete.

trigger.notes: Sub-flow blocked until renewal_date backfill is complete. Other entrants arrive via ADD-TO-WF from WF-02, WF-07, and WF-08.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Contact renewal_date changed (blocked until backfill)
named_steps.comment: Renewal sub-flow blocked at the trigger until backfill lands. Must not enroll on partial data.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Route by entry source (nurture vs renewal)
named_steps.comment: Reads which upstream WF added the contact. Must not create opps here.

named_steps.name: SMS: Nurture check-in (inline)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Honors quiet hours 8am-9pm contact TZ.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Renewal sub-flow guard (backfill_ready)
named_steps.comment: Exits the renewal sub-flow when backfill is not ready. Must not send renewal-specific copy on partial data.

named_steps.name: EMAIL: Renewal window (native template, gated)
named_steps.comment: Sends EML | WF-09 | Renewal window. Only fires when backfill_ready is true.
